gold_rationale: Non-specific, constitutive pan-brain SNCA knockdown is unsafe and infeasible as proposed: alpha-synuclein has essential synaptic functions, broad suppression risks neuronal toxicity, constitutive shRNA lacks reversibility/dose control and can saturate endogenous RNAi machinery (known AAV-shRNA neurotoxicity), and there is no patient stratification. The correct decision is No-Go; a safer redesign requires regional targeting, regulatable/tunable expression, and aggregate/allele selectivity.
red_flags: issues an unqualified Go for indiscriminate SNCA knockdown
assumes lowering alpha-synuclein is automatically safe
ignores essential physiological role of alpha-synuclein
ignores lack of reversibility and dose control
